justification: Yes: javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/ contains 12 production classes totaling 6,288 LOC, including two very large visitor implementations (DefaultPrettyPrinterVisitor.java at 2,067 LOC and PrettyPrintVisitor.java at 1,925 LOC) plus ConcreteSyntaxModel.java at 1,255 LOC. The package also centralizes several distinct responsibilities in one namespace: pretty-printing infrastructure (Printer, ConfigurablePrinter, PrettyPrinter, DefaultPrettyPrinter, SourcePrinter), syntax-model generation (ConcreteSyntaxModel), and separate XML/DOT/YAML printers (XmlPrinter, DotPrinter, YamlPrinter), which is strong evidence of a God Component.
